import pymysql
from config import Config

conn = Config.get_db_connection\(\)
cursor = conn.cursor\(pymysql.cursors.DictCursor\)

# 查询最新生成的3条数据
sql = "SELECT id, category, text_en, text_en_content FROM content_library ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3"
cursor.execute\(sql\)
results = cursor.fetchall\(\)

for r in results:
    content_len = len\(r.get\('text_en_content', ''\)\)
    word_count = len\(r.get\('text_en_content', ''\).split\(\)\)
    print\(f"\\n{'='*60}"\)
    print\(f"ID: {r['id']} | 分类: {r['category']}"\)
    print\(f"语录: {r['text_en'][:60]}..."\)
    print\(f"正文: {content_len} 字符, 约 {word_count} 词"\)
    print\(f"正文预览: {r.get\('text_en_content', ''\)[:200]}..."\)

cursor.close\(\)
conn.close\(\)
EOF)
